about: A small feature with an exact output contract, and the existing output must not change.

goals.title: Machine-readable report
goals.objective: Other tools can read tally's report.

todos.text: Add a --json option to `tally report`: it prints one JSON object {"byCategory": {...}, "byMonth": {...}, "total": ...} in which every amount is a string formatted exactly like the text report's (for example "-102.23"). Without --json the report stays exactly as it is. Add a test.
